Galaxy S26 GPU gate (round 16, Session path, greedy): 4/4 questions, long prompt missed, the same points as the file without the 16-token signature on the same phone. Previous file on the same Mac in the same lock window (litert-lm 0.17.1, same flags): gpu p256 d256: decode 65.0 tok/s, prefill 643.78 tok/s, TTFT 0.418 s; gpu p16 d32: decode 62.88 tok/s, prefill 80.3 tok/s, TTFT 0.2198 s; cpu p256 d256: decode 18.15 tok/s, prefill 64.71 tok/s, TTFT 4.8685 s; cpu p16 d32: decode 12.09 tok/s, prefill 8.14 tok/s, TTFT 2.8925 s.
quantization: int4 weights - blockwise (block 32) + OCTAV optimal-clipping, symmetric; embedding INT8
